description: This file contains C# source code with partial class and extension method definitions related to Orleans clustering using ZooKeeper. It defines options classes, extension methods for configuring clustering, and implementations for membership and gateway list provider classes specific to ZooKeeper integration.

classes.name: ZooKeeperClusteringSiloOptions
classes.description: Options class for ZooKeeper clustering silo configuration, contains a connection string.

classes.name: ZooKeeperGatewayListProviderOptions
classes.description: Options class for ZooKeeper gateway list provider configuration, contains a connection string.

classes.name: ZooKeeperHostingExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods for configuring Orleans clients and silos to use ZooKeeper clustering.

classes.name: ZooKeeperBasedMembershipTable
classes.description: Implementation of IMembershipTable for managing silo membership using ZooKeeper.

classes.name: ZooKeeperGatewayListProvider
classes.description: Implementation of IGatewayListProvider for providing gateway address lists from ZooKeeper.

methods.name: UseZooKeeperClustering
methods.description: Extension methods for IClientBuilder and ISiloBuilder to configure ZooKeeper clustering with options.

methods.name: CleanupDefunctSiloEntries
methods.description: Removes stale silo entries from the ZooKeeper-based membership table.

methods.name: DeleteMembershipTableEntries
methods.description: Deletes all membership table entries for a given cluster.

methods.name: InitializeMembershipTable
methods.description: Initializes the ZooKeeper-based membership table, optionally trying to initialize the path.

methods.name: InsertRow
methods.description: Inserts a membership entry into the membership table.

methods.name: ReadAll
methods.description: Reads all membership data from ZooKeeper.

methods.name: ReadRow
methods.description: Reads the membership data for a specific silo address.

methods.name: UpdateIAmAlive
methods.description: Updates 'I am alive' status for a membership entry.

methods.name: UpdateRow
methods.description: Updates a membership row with a new entry.

methods.name: GetGateways
methods.description: Retrieves the list of gateway URIs from ZooKeeper.
